component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.watermark.copies.types
component.documentation: Since 0.6.0, a long video's marked copy, WatermarkedCopy, kept in a folder of its own, WatermarkedCopies, which the background job creates below the repository's root, its inheritance blocked so that no one but the system reads it. Neither type is shown in navigation, versioned or commented. The download permission refuses a copy's file to everyone, administrators included, wherever it is asked for; only Asset.GetWatermarked serves it, to the person its key names, once the rights allow the use.
